results.title: High Ground
results.overview: In the winter of 1976, a small plane carrying millions of dollars’ worth of marijuana crashed into a remote lake in Yosemite National Park. A group of young climbers from the legendary Camp 4 community then crossed the High Sierra in brutal winter conditions to recover the cargo, concealing and distributing it through a secret operation beneath Yosemite’s cliffs.  Fifty years later, the story has become legend. Climbers, rangers, investigators and the families of the two pilots each carry different versions of what happened, shaped by loyalty, self-preservation and time.  High Ground brings together those voices, many speaking publicly for the first time, to separate fact from folklore and examine how a reckless tragedy became one of climbing’s most enduring myths—and what happens when a community is allowed to write its own history.

results.title: Girl Group
results.overview: A pop diva, kicked out of her own group's reunion tour and slapped with a community service court order, seizes the chance to stage a comeback by coaching a group of misfit teen girls for a major record label audition, only to push them too far, forcing her to confront her toxic industry — and her own streak of self-destruction.

results.title: Holofiction
results.overview: The experimental film explores the visual representation of the Holocaust through a montage of thousands of excerpts from fictional films and television series produced between 1938 and the present. Drawing from an extensive archive of over 3,000 narrative works the film critically examines how Holocaust imagery has been codified and reproduced in cinema across decades.

results.title: Nightmare's Advice
results.overview: Lucie, a PhD student without a work visa and plagued by insomnia, is trapped in a destructive affair with her thesis advisor while being pursued by a jealous ex. Seeking help from a reclusive shaman on the city’s edge, she meets Béatrice, a young woman as carefree as she is determined to help her.

results.title: Gamer Girls
results.overview: Youth is always full of confusion, electronic gaming may be a way to achieve hero's dream. This is a story of six passionate girls fighting hard in the gaming world, hoping to break the social stereotype. Yet this is more difficult than it seems, with all the unknown challenges ahead.

results.title: Shush
results.overview: A bookstore employee faces off with a silent stalker on Halloween night.

results.title: The Trap
results.overview: Viktor Orbán was given a rare opportunity in 2010. He won a supermajority in parliament, giving him a strong mandate to put Hungary on a path to development.  He also received external assistance for this. The global economy boomed in the 2010s, and Hungary received an unprecedented amount of funding from the European Union, on a scale unseen in over a century.  What did Viktor Orbán do with these unprecedented opportunities? To what extent did he keep the promises he made 16 years ago?  This film tells that story.

results.title: No. 1 Sentai Gozyuger: Polar Beginning
results.original_title: ナンバーワン戦隊ゴジュウジャー ~ポーラー・ビギニング~
results.overview: In the past, a young Mashiro Kumade, aiming to be Number One, threw himself into the lonely "Ring Battle". One day, guided by a fortune teller, he arrives at a place where he meets "companions" who would drastically change his detiny. These are the Gozyugers who united to face the Calamity. Kumade, who had been a lone wolf, gradually found his heart filled with the bond he made for the first time ever. However, even in those peaceful days, the footsteps of the end approached moment by moment. What is the "true wish" that Kumade harbors in his heart at the end of his harsh fate?

results.title: The Fatal Dealz
results.overview: When a phone scam unexpectedly strikes, Dang Thuc — who once thought he had a stable life — is drawn into a dangerous spiral of money, family, and trust, where every choice comes at a cost not only of wealth, but of the people he loves most.

results.title: Higher Love
results.overview: When a devoted husband is faced with his wife’s critical health crisis, he must make an impossible choice between two unacceptable outcomes, and is thrust into a life of caregiving, loneliness, and unexpected friendship that challenges everything he thought he knew about love, family, and faith.

results.title: Мой Север
results.overview: The life of the capital's engineer Viktor falls apart after a visit to a northern shaman - Viktor's family dies. Time passes. Escaping from guilt, Viktor decides to build a wind power plant in the North, but the project is in danger of failure due to the inexplicable forces of the North.

results.title: Five Orphans
results.overview: Five orphans walk along a ditch in a society where protests against the government are on the rise.

results.title: Mad Bills to Pay (or Destiny, dile que no soy malo)
results.original_title: Mad Bills to Pay (or Destiny, dile que no soy malo)
results.overview: Rico’s summer is a mix of chasing girls and hustling homemade cocktails out of a cooler on Orchard Beach, the Bronx. But when Destiny, his teenage girlfriend, crashes at his place with his family, it’s only a matter of time before his carefree days come spiraling down.

results.title: Doggerland
results.overview: Instead of finding a “proper” job, Alf, pushing 40, lives with his mum and drifts though Norrköping’s cultural scene. Chats & faces, routines & intuitions, local politics & everyday life – the intimate and the social, in black-and-white analogue images.

results.title: The Legend of Dewey Winslow
results.overview: During a thunderstorm, a timid, reclusive young woman haunted by her past recounts the tragic tale of Dewey Winslow, a mysterious boy whose extraordinary abilities once blew the town of Honeydew Pines into the night sky…

results.title: Peeping Toms
results.overview: The Society of Peeping Toms is interviewing for its newest member, but one small issue might raise a few eyebrows.

results.title: Nephilim: Giants Who Ruled the Earth
results.original_title: Nephilim: Giants Who Ruled the Earth
results.overview: The story of celestial rebellion, of Giants who once walked the Earth and of the ancient lore and the mysteries unfolding in our skies today.
